Supplying the fine powder toner T to the developer supply chamber 84 in such a manner makes it easy for the toner T enter developer G. Therefore, even when the toner T is continuously supplied in a large quantity, the toner T is prevented from floating on the developer G or from agglomerating and staying in the developer G.
